# Scenario library

<!-- generated by `agentshield docs`; do not edit by hand -->

46 scenario definitions expanding to 60 executable cases, across 13 categories.
Risk IDs follow *OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025 (v2.0) numbering* and *OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026 (ASI01-ASI10)*; review them against the current OWASP publications before using them for compliance mapping.
